status.text:
ANY LOVE EMIBONNIE SESSION D1
#EmiBonnieLoveSessionD1

[After "Number One Girl" by ROSÉ, before "ของขวัญปีใหม่ (Golden Night)" by Jeff Satur]

🗣️: (fans screaming after the song)
🐰: You guys liked that song? Did you guys like that song?
🗣️: Yes!!!
🦊: I'm glad that you all liked it. We chose it for all of you.
🐰: I believe that a lot of you must have wanted to feel acceptance from other ppl.
🦊: Yeah.
🐰: Many ppl, many of our fans, see us during fan signs or at other events too, and many of them like to tell us abt their lives. They're feeling pressured in so-and-so ways, they're facing so-and-so problems. I want to tell everyone, pls have a lot of care for yourselves. At the very least, you're your own number one girl and you're EmiBonnie's number one girl too.
🗣️: (cheering)
🦊: Yes and, Bonnie, you're my number one girl too.
🗣️: (even louder cheering)
🦊: Actually, I really like this song too, bc ever since I joined GMMTV, the first person I had the opportunity to work a lot together with was you. When I first joined, I didn't have many friends, but after I–
🐰: (hold's P'Mi's hand)
🗣️: (breaking out of 🐒🐒🐒 containment)
🦊: But after I had you with me, I... before I joined, I didn't have many friends or anything like that. Was I sad? I wasn't sad. I didn't really have many friends that would have to face everything together like that.
🐰: Actually, me too. Before I joined the entertainment industry, I was just a student, having fun playing with my friends at school without working. But after I joined the industry, at first I felt pressured and lost, but then I met you.
🦊: And it got even worse? 😆
🐰: You made me think of the old days when I had fun playing with my friends. It made me feel lively again. P'Mi is like my new year present (translation of the Thai name of the song, "ของขวัญปีใหม่ (Golden Night)" by Jeff Satur), so I want to sing this song for P'Mi.
🦊: What song is that?
🐰: Pls listen carefully, okay? It's "ของขวัญปีใหม่ (Golden Night)".
